# Orizon Press
Orizon Press is an independent publishing house based in Ghana, publishing works in African history, consciousness, spirituality, fiction, and Christian literature.

## Authors
- J.N. Nartey: African history, textbooks, consciousness
- JOJO Penwood: Fiction, spirituality, African cosmos
- Ajona Penhart: Christian literature, spirituality

## About
Independent. Global. Uncompromising. Publishing works that reach beyond the horizon.
